run_upload_gmock: run upload_gmock.py to upload a Google Mock patch for review with the discussion group cc'd
run_upload_gmock_with_cc: run upload_gmock.py with custom --cc flags to add extra reviewers alongside the Google Mock group
review_main: review the main function that wraps upload.py and auto-appends the Google Mock mailing list to cc
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support additional default cc groups beyond the Google Mock group
summarize_upload_gmock: summarize the upload_gmock.py wrapper script that passes all args to upload.py with an added cc flag
